build_mlp_default: build a two-layer MLP with GELU activation and default hidden size equal to input features
create_mlp_custom_hidden: create an MLP with a custom hidden feature dimension and ReLU activation layer
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP with dropout regularization applied after each linear layer
run_mlp_forward: run a forward pass through the MLP module with a PyTorch tensor input
review_mlp_bias: review the MLP class to toggle bias on or off for both linear layers
